title.en: Turn Pixels into Black and White

brief.zh: 从四个亮度数字出发，看看阈值怎样生成一张黑白图。
brief.en: See how a threshold turns four brightness values into a black-and-white image.

concept.zh: 每个像素都会和同一个亮度阈值比较
concept.en: Each pixel is compared against the same brightness threshold

body.zh: 一张灰度图可以看成一格格的数字。0 是黑色，255 是白色，中间的数表示不同亮度。
body.en: A grayscale image is a grid of numbers. 0 is black, 255 is white, and values in between describe different brightness levels.

body.zh: 用 OpenCV 的二值阈值处理时，亮度大于阈值的像素变白，其余变黑。白色像素连在一起就组成一个区域。
body.en: With OpenCV’s binary threshold, values strictly above the threshold turn white. The rest turn black. Touching white pixels form a region.

body.zh: 高斯模糊用周围一小片像素的加权值替换当前像素。先模糊再做阈值处理时，边缘的读数可能跨过阈值，让白色区域变大或变小。
body.en: Gaussian blur replaces each pixel with a weighted combination of nearby pixels. Blurring before thresholding can move edge values across the threshold, changing the size of the white regions.

caption.en: This tiny image has four pixels.

caption.zh: 阈值是 100，只有下方两个像素超过它。
caption.en: At a threshold of 100, only the bottom two pixels pass.

caption.zh: 下方两个像素变白。它们相邻，所以只算一个区域。
caption.en: The bottom pixels turn white. They touch, so they make a single region.

prompt.zh: 把阈值改成 200，几个像素会变白？
prompt.en: How many pixels turn white if you set the threshold to 200?

feedback.en: Only the value 211 is greater than 200.
